release_notes: Reliability stress test: Fully verified zero-touch OTA fleet update with memory-scoped TLS stack and direct URL streaming.

changelog.notes: Verified repeated wireless Over-The-Air firmware flash and instant cloud reconnection.
Live fleet update test: Enhanced TLS handshake headroom and instant state sync.
Verified wireless Over-The-Air update from GitHub Pages with expanded 16KB TLS buffer.
Added persistent non-volatile run cycle logging in EEPROM (Start/Stop triggers, duration, timestamps) with zero flash wear, MQTT cycle telemetry, and weekly usage analytics.
Added autonomous Over-The-Air (OTA) updates from GitHub Pages and remote 1-click fleet trigger without physical buttons.
Direct Hardware Touch ISR (<1us latency) at 160MHz overclock with safe Hi-Z relay driver.
Commercial 50-year zero-cloud architecture with decentralized HiveMQ MQTT and local HTTP portal.
